announcement.title: Online via Zoom
announcement.text:
Dear brothers and sisters! 🙏

We would like to remind you that our online prayer meeting will take place Tuesday at 8:30 PM.

We invite you to join us in prayer for the people who received books, for our families, our church, and spiritual revival.

May the Lord bless the seeds of truth that have been planted and touch people's hearts through the work of the Holy Spirit.

We will be happy to see everyone! 🙏
